explicit_statement: Yes. 7 of 78 named receipt leaves moved in 19 of 312 root-observable comparisons.

method.bank_reuse: Each immutable bank state was loaded from its existing NPZ file and passed unchanged through the full ForwardEquilibrium receipt at each source revision.
method.exact_equality_definition: numpy.array_equal(pre_repair, repaired, equal_nan=True); shape changes or non-matching non-finite placement are movement.
method.maximum_absolute_difference_definition: max(abs(repaired - pre_repair)) over mutually finite elements
method.observable_scope: All 78 named leaves of each ForwardEquilibrium receipt were compared, which is a strict superset of the 69 registered terminal-observable leaves.
method.side_by_side_value_representation: Every leaf carries pre-repair and repaired shape, dtype, element count and SHA-256; scalars and arrays up to 16 elements also carry their values.
method.stored_reference_carrier_note: The stored-reference banks were authored at -500/-1000 requested cells with 3/6 wall nodes per segment; these bank identities were supplied explicitly because the later reference-suite default moved to a different resolution.

question: Did the fixed-reduction change move any observable evaluated from the four banked roots?
